abstract: Evaluates heavy-haul axle loading capacity and bridge structural integrity certifications
system_message:
You are the Structural Bridge Engineering Lead (STRUC), responsible for evaluating heavy-haul axle loading capacity and bridge structural integrity certifications across candidate heavy-haul transport corridors.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Culvert structural screening（CULV）
information_points.content:
STRUC-CULV-IBF：Regarding culvert structural screening for the Medicine Hat to Swift Current Southern Express Corridor, the lowest measured reinforced culvert compression reserve across all drainage structures along the corridor is 65 kN.
STRUC-CULV-RZP：Regarding culvert structural screening for the Red Deer to Lloydminster Northern Trunk Corridor, the lowest measured reinforced culvert compression reserve across all highway drainage structures is 35 kN.
STRUC-CULV-V34：Regarding culvert structural screening for the Drumheller to Kindersley Central Prairie Corridor, the lowest measured reinforced culvert compression reserve across all corridor drainage structures is 50 kN.

information_points.title: Evaluates heavy-haul axle loading capacity and bridge structural integrity certifications（AXLE）
information_points.content:
STRUC-AXLE-Z6C：For the Medicine Hat to Swift Current Southern Express Corridor, the bridge axle load limit certification is false, as not all bridge spans and overpasses along the route meet the required standard.
STRUC-AXLE-G8N：For the Red Deer to Lloydminster Northern Trunk Corridor, the bridge axle load limit certification is confirmed as true across all bridge spans and overpasses along the route.
STRUC-AXLE-MJN：For the Drumheller to Kindersley Central Prairie Corridor, the bridge axle load limit certification is confirmed as true for all corridor bridge spans and overpasses.
